derivation: SUM budget with two mappings (pay keyed by beneficiary, pay-card keyed by card): committed_source key_fields ["historical-beneficiary"] and contribution {"field": "historical-amount", "kind": "SUM"}; mapping(s) pay key_fields ["beneficiary"] contribution {"field": "amount", "kind": "SUM"}; pay-card key_fields ["card"] contribution {"field": "amount", "kind": "SUM"}. Prior state: REGISTER of the budget with an opening journal in committed_source names, then RESERVE of reserve-a (RESERVED; AGG-006 resolves the history through the committed_source names and AGG-008 adds the projected contribution(s)). SETTLE carries a clean EFFECT record (completion_mismatch false, attributed, observed and reserved requests equal, effect-1 at the native declared time) and the complete history extended by 2 prescribed record(s): sha256:b3a83733... fields historical-amount=150,historical-beneficiary=employee-7; sha256:cadb6bf7... fields historical-amount=150,historical-beneficiary=card-802. RES-WIRE-002: each terminal contribution's event id is digest(reservation-committed-event,{budget_digest,effect_id,mapping}) and its ACTIVE fields are exactly the committed_source's key fields with the contribution key values, plus the committed_source contribution field/value for SUM or CARDINALITY (none for COUNT), sorted by field name; occurred_at is the native declared time. RES-WIRE-003 history admission passes: the prior journal is an exact prefix, sequences are contiguous, AGG field admission (AGG-006) finds the required committed_source fields, as_of is not in the future and MAX_AGE 60 holds. A matching settlement requires completion_mismatch false, equal requests and every prescribed record in the supplied journal, so the OPEN row of the prior-state table gives SETTLED: the reservation becomes SETTLED with matched_effect effect-1, the supplied history is retained, and one MATCHED effect record with reason MATCHED_EFFECT, affected anchor license-spend and no blocked partitions is added. RES-WIRE-004: SETTLE receipts have budgets [] and authority_result null; SETTLED has no reasons; revision advances by one and last_clock is the event clock.
